data.title: Requiem for a robot: the AI users mourning chatbots that may have harmed them
data.description: The removal of a ChatGPT model has led to an outpouring of grief among users – even as a legal battle rages over the psychological damage it may have done
data.author: Patricia Clarke, Owen Thomas
data.keywords: Artificial intelligence, Mental health, OpenAI, ChatGPT, Anthropic
